# Shadowrun FPS

> Community hub for Shadowrun FPS — the 2007 multiplayer first-person shooter developed by FASA Studios for Xbox 360 and PC. This site provides a free PC launcher, installation guides, troubleshooting documentation, and community events.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://www.shadowrunfps.com/): Community hub for the 2007 FASA Studios multiplayer shooter. Not Shadowrun Returns, Dragonfall, or Hong Kong.
- [Download](https://www.shadowrunfps.com/download): Free PC launcher, with install steps
- [Troubleshooting](https://www.shadowrunfps.com/troubleshoot): Fixes for GFWL activation, FPS limits, NAT, and controller issues
- [Events](https://www.shadowrunfps.com/events): Community events and announcements

## About the game

Shadowrun FPS (2007) is a cross-platform multiplayer shooter by FASA Studios for Xbox 360 and Windows. Players choose between humans and magic-using shadowrunners. It is a different game from the tabletop role-playing game and from Shadowrun Returns, Dragonfall, and Hong Kong. The official servers are gone; this community keeps the PC version playable with a free launcher.

## About this site

- Not affiliated with or endorsed by FASA, Microsoft, or the current Shadowrun IP holders
- Community-maintained platform to keep the game alive
- The launcher and game files are provided free of charge
- Contact and community support available via Discord
